about: Per-store decisions applied by tools/merge.mjs that need evidence no automatic rule can see. Every entry names the official record (chain + exact name in tools/seed/web/<chain>.json) or the OSM element, says what to do and carries its evidence. manualPlacements.about: The 32 stores that no rule could place (REPORT.md §4 before 2026-10-01), decided from evidence: official map links (only the coordinates in the redirect URL were read), OSM features (malls, buildings, blocks, neighbourhood polygons), house-number interpolation on OSM streets, press descriptions. Each store was researched and then independently re-checked (tools/seed/manual/<batch>-research.json and <batch>-verdicts.json); lat/lng, precision and status are the verifier's. tools/merge.mjs applies them after all matching and geocoding, only to records that are still unplaced: "link" entries match the official record to an OSM element already in the database (no new row); the others place the official/press record (source web, official URL, id web-<chain>-<slug>); "reject" entries stay in REPORT.md §4 with the verifier's reason. note is the Spanish text written to the notes column; method, evidence and verification stay in English (REPORT.md §4, "Colocación manual").
